the colour reference for the new webbing: a deep muted RIDGE BLUE that sits near-opposite the current orange webbing on the colour wheel, a distance a simple hue move cannot cross without desaturating and losing the weave

the flat screen-size mark export: FAR BELOW hero size (so it can only reach hero size by enlargement unless rebuilt as geometry), and what looks transparent is actually an OPAQUE WHITE CARD baked in behind the mark (invisible until it lands on the brand charcoal)

the same mark SCREEN-PRINTED on a woven webbing label sewn to a strap: naming 'the label' returns the whole label patch rather than the print, and the ink sits down in the weave so the strokes break up along the warp threads (invisible at viewing size, fatal at trace level)

clean range list, nine rows; working loads are stated as certified and must not be changed or rounded; the colourways column names which SKUs are launching in Ridge Blue (the second colourway) so the reconciliation is checkable; no column encodes which frames are clipped or which eyes are holes
